notes:
Access: Direct HTTP (curl_cffi, Chrome-impersonation) worked for the homepage, robots.txt and all sitemap XML files, but every /c/... category (PLP) URL returned Akamai 'Access Denied' (403, errors.edgesuite.net) regardless of headers/session warm-up. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only generic bot blocks for CazoodleBot/MJ12bot/dotbot/Gigabot; Googlebot explicitly allowed). Escalated to Playwright/Chromium (headless, both bundled Chromium and real Chrome channel, with stealth flags) - blocked on every request including the homepage (Akamai 'Powered and protected by Akamai' interstitial), so escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) which reached every page normally via the user's real browser session - used this tier for all category verification. robots.txt was fetched via curl_cffi before any Claude-in-Chrome use, per policy.

Discovery: fetched sitemap-index.xml -> category-sitemap.xml (7800+ lines) and grepped for christmas/halloween/diwali/deepavali/easter/valentine/vday/thanksgiving/new-year/mothers-day/fathers-day/holi/rakhi/eid/navratri/festive/holiday - found extensive Christmas and Easter category trees and a smaller Halloween tree; zero matches for Diwali, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, or any Indian/other festival anywhere in the category sitemap. Also checked content-sitemap.xml (editorial/landing pages only - excluded per marketing-page rule) and the /home-and-lifestyle department page's 'Shop by category' list (Appliances, Bathroom, Bedroom, Dining, DIY, Furniture, Gym and fitness, Home decor, Heaters, Kitchen, Laundry, Lighting, Outdoor living, Party cards & wrap, Pets, Storage, Travel) - no seasonal/holiday entry sits at that level; seasonal categories live under a separate top-level /christmas and /easter/... /halloween hub structure. Site-search (/search?q=diwali) returned a broken 'please enter a search term' response for this URL pattern, so was not used as evidence; absence conclusions rest on the sitemap/category-tree check instead, per the zero-result-search-is-not-proof rule.

Seasonal timing note: checked 2026-09-04 (Southern Hemisphere spring, ~3.5 months before Christmas). Many sitemap-listed Christmas decor URLs (Christmas Decorations, Christmas Tree Decorations, Christmas Trees, Christmas Lights, Christmas Wreaths, ornaments/baubles/tree-toppers/stockings) are live URLs but currently return 'No products found' (0 items) and are also absent from the live Christmas-hub subnav, i.e. the 2026 Christmas decor range has not been merchandised online yet. Per the shared core rule '0-product categories are dropped rather than written as a zero row,' these were NOT included as rows. Only currently-stocked Christmas branches were captured: Christmas Homewares (Bedding + Kitchen linens/kitchenware in Christmas print) and Christmas Gift Wrapping & Cards (1 SKU). Christmas Bath & Body, Christmas Crafts, Christmas Food, Christmas Outfits, Christmas Toys, Novelty Gifts and Gift Guides were excluded as out of the home/decor scope (personal care, hobby/craft, food, apparel, toys, generic gifts, marketing page respectively) per the task's 'scope strictly to home/decor-relevant seasonal categories' instruction.

Halloween: the only currently live/stocked Halloween node is the top hub (16 products - all kids costumes, clothing, accessories, a book), which is out of scope (fashion/toys, not home decor). The one home-decor-relevant Halloween branch, 'Halloween Home Decor & Decorations' (/c/halloween/halloween-home/W0808246), returned 0 products (pre-season) and was dropped per the same 0-product rule. Result: no valid Halloween row.

Easter: fully merchandised now (~7 months before Easter, but Easter home decor appears to run on a longer lead time than Christmas on this site, or last season's stock is still live). 'Easter Decorations' (/c/easter/easter-decorations/W1468702, 93 products) and its only subnav child 'Home' (/c/easter/easter-decorations/home/W1468793, also 93 products, identical evidence/count) are the same underlying listing - kept one row per the overlap rule, noted here rather than duplicated. Several other Easter URLs found in the sitemap (/c/easter/W911593, /c/easter/W1045680, /c/easter/easter-home-essentials/W1468715, /c/easter/easter-eggs/W1046201, /c/easter/easter-decorations/home/napery/W1468806) are retired/legacy category IDs that now 302-redirect to the current 'Easter Home & Homewares' (W1468793) node - confirmed by direct navigation, not included as separate rows. Within that node, 'Bedding' (89 products) and 'Dinnerware' (1 product) are genuine narrower PLPs with their own subnav entries and counts; a third subnav entry 'Napery' exists in the UI but its link resolves back to the parent page rather than a distinct listing, so it was not captured as a separate row (the ~3-product gap between the parent's 93 and Bedding+Dinnerware's 90 is attributable to Napery items visible only within the parent listing). Easter fashion/clothing/kids-licensed branches (easter-sleepwear, easter-kidswear, easter-babywear, easter-hunting/kidswear, kids/licensed) were excluded as out of the home/decor scope.

No Diwali, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, or other festival category exists anywhere in the site's category taxonomy (confirmed via full category-sitemap grep, not merely a nav glance).

rows.evidence: 93 products found (identical to the 'Home' subcategory listing at /c/easter/easter-decorations/home/W1468793 - duplicate, see notes)
